item.title: [Training Data] A Model For Everyone: How Ronak From Trajectory Is Building Products For Continual Learning
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:32 A lot of our philosophy in product actually comes from Apple. In, like, the early two thousands, you had a computer that had access to the Internet, and you had a phone that you could make phone calls. And I think no one really thought to put the two together until Apple said, okay. What if you actually put the Internet on a handheld device and combine the two?
